سررتما (form I)
# سَرَرْتُمَا (sarartumā) /sa.rar.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
# سُرِرْتُمَا (surirtumā) /su.rir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# سَرِرْتُمَا (sarirtumā) /sa.rir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of سَرَّ (sarra)
